title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S02 E04 — The Legend of Nat Love
When Black cowboy Nat Love overnights in Deadwood during a cattle drive, he decides to enter a Fourth of July cowboy competition; confident in his roping, riding, and shooting skills, he is eager to test his mettle against the best cowboys around.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S02 E02 — The Texas Fence-Cutting War
When homesteaders keep cutting down her fences to access grazing land and water, a widowed landowner teams up with Texas Ranger Ira Aten to protect her property; Aten hopes his explosive plan of action will force the cutters to compromise.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S04 E05 — John Coffee Hays: A Texas Legend
Tennessee native John Coffee Hays heads to the frontier of Texas in the 1830s and signs on as an early member of the Texas Rangers, and in 1844 he becomes a legend when he leads a small band in a desperate fight with the Comanche.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S05 E02 — Don't Mess With Texas
The cowboys head to Texas on a mission to broker their first cattle deal; Cody decides it is time to start his own rodeo; Bubba and Kaley take in a struggling cowboy while he looks for work; Booger and Jaclyn get serious about buying a piece of land.

title: Maverick
description:

For months, a thin wall of rock is all that keeps the peace between two rival silver mining companies in the Idaho mountains; when the barrier is finally breached, pickaxes give way to pistols and rifles, and the miners battle for five days.

description:

After the suspicious death of a tunnel worker, and unconvincing answers from the project's lead engineer, Doc Susie goes on a covert mission to find out what happened; deep underground, she finds her own life in peril when she's trapped by a cave-in.
